name: P3 Semantic Mutation
install: if [ -f scripts/cloud-agent-install.sh ]; then bash scripts/cloud-agent-install.sh; else set -euo pipefail; if ! python3 -c 'import ensurepip, venv' >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo apt-get update; sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y python3-venv python3-dev; fi; mkdir -p "$HOME/.venvs"; [ -x "$HOME/.venvs/p3/bin/python" ] || python3 -m venv "$HOME/.venvs/p3"; "$HOME/.venvs/p3/bin/python" -m pip install --upgrade pip; "$HOME/.venvs/p3/bin/pip" install -r requirements-frozen.txt; fi
start: if [ -f scripts/cloud-agent-start.sh ]; then bash scripts/cloud-agent-start.sh; else ln -sfn "$HOME/.venvs/p3" .venv; fi
